findings.finding: Support PR also changes DRIVER_WS_URL default used by operational order/offer sockets. References: websocket_service.dart:319; driver_websocket_service.dart:22; app_config.dart:64.
findings.decision: Do not import global endpoint change. Isolate LIVE_CHAT_WS_URL after mapping current deployed support contract. Operational endpoint must remain current.

findings.finding: Dart channel becomes com.wiz.wizmerchantapp/statement-export; source Android MainActivity.kt:21 still listens to com.whizz.merchants/statement-export. iOS counterpart was changed. Android export channel contract is inconsistent.
findings.decision: Hold this change; separate coordinated native export fix and device test.

findings.finding: Source changes route fallback and ETA validation and introduces configurable wallet transfer endpoint. These affect financial request inputs, failure paths and target service, even without an intended price-formula rewrite.
findings.decision: Exclude from support-only work; preserve current staged and unstaged pricing and transfer behavior.

findings.finding: Support service depends on access-token refresh while the PR also rewrites global recovery/error behavior and wraps wallet UI with AuthSurface.
findings.decision: Use existing identity contract for extracted support; global authentication changes need separate baseline comparisons.

findings.path: Android/iOS native build and release policy/configuration
findings.finding: Mixed PRs change release signing, target SDK, dependency locks, app labels and hardcoded privacy screens. Customer Android label reintroduces the long name recently removed. Driver settings retains a System theme selector while our apps now use light only.
findings.decision: Do not overwrite current Android parity, Maps correction, native splash, names, guest account UI or centrally managed policies.

findings.finding: New support identity schema requires authVersion=2 and explicit app pools; file and deployment also serve shared websocket routes. New receipt/attachment tables and private bucket are required. Existing sessions and route consumers need compatibility review.
findings.decision: No generic handler swap or deployment during review. Isolate support paths, explicit environment and least privilege; verify event routing before rollout.
